apmYml:
name: full-stack
version: "0.0.0"
targets:
  - claude
  - codex
  - copilot
  - cursor
  - kiro
dependencies:
  apm:
    - git: anthropics/skills/skills/frontend-design
      ref: "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"
      targets:
        - agent-skills
        - claude
    - ./vendor/full
    - ./vendor/full--plugin-release-tools
  mcp:
    - name: io.github.upstash/context7
      registry: false
      transport: http
      url: "https://mcp.context7.com/mcp"
      headers:
        CONTEXT7_API_KEY: "${CONTEXT7_API_KEY}"
    - name: microsoft/playwright-mcp
      registry: false
      transport: stdio
      command: npx
      args:
        - "-y"
        - "@playwright/mcp@latest"
      env:
        BROWSER_TOKEN: "${BROWSER_TOKEN}"
        LOG_LEVEL: info
  lsp:
    - name: typescript
      command: typescript-language-server
      args:
        - "--stdio"
      extensionToLanguage:
        ".ts": typescript
        ".tsx": typescriptreact
      transport: stdio

notes.message: `format-on-save` is a hook: it runs commands on harness lifecycle events. It compiles into the vendored package, and APM holds hooks from a dependency until `apm approve` allows them when its executable gate is on. Read it before installing.

`context7` compiles to a `dependencies.mcp` object, the form APM documents, which the published OpenAPM v0.1 JSON Schema rejects for every MCP object; the spec's prose is authoritative, so it is checked against APM's own rules instead
`linear` is relayed by ShelfKit, so it compiles to no `dependencies.mcp` entry: an agent reaches its tools through the shelf's `/mcp` endpoint, as `linear__<tool>`

`playwright` compiles to a `dependencies.mcp` object, the form APM documents, which the published OpenAPM v0.1 JSON Schema rejects for every MCP object; the spec's prose is authoritative, so it is checked against APM's own rules instead
target `kiro` is outside the OpenAPM v0.1 producer set, so this profile's manifest is Producer-nonconformant (opted in)
`typescript-language-server` compiles to `dependencies.lsp`, which is absent from the published OpenAPM v0.1 schema: it passes validation without being defined by it
